text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon managed to achieve brilliant results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through
those truly precious "first three years"—

And so, one day while still basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone.

Agnes Tachyon came to the trainer's office,
saying she wanted to do a psychological test.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
" 'Something is buried in the dirt of the backyard.
Now then, what could be buried there?' "

...I don't know what his true intentions are,
but it seems I have no choice but to go along with it.

Speaking of things buried in the dirt—
I let my thoughts wander.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: “...... 'It is something that you yourself wish someone would uncover.'”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, that can't be right!
I got saddled with another fake.
"Hits the bullseye every time" is a blatant exaggeration.
Still, I wanted to know what caused her to suddenly get into personality quizzes in the first place.
choice_data_list: What's with the sudden psychological test?
What's with the sudden psychological test?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm researching the fundamental nature of social animals.
Namely, 'emotions.'"

I feel like, sometime long ago,
she said something just like that—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I've recently developed quite an interest
in the power generated by "enthusiasm" and "passion."

"Thinking back on it, she had shown an interest
in 'emotions' since quite a long time ago."

I thought it was just temporary,
but apparently that's not quite the case.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...It hit me with an unbelievable punch.
From the audience seats of the Arima Kinen, that is."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"After crossing the finish line in 1st place that day...
I was enveloped in an explosion of cheers."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Such overwhelming power... it makes my skin prickle
and the core of my heart tremble. I was left completely stunned.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, suddenly,
a single possibility crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—The fact that I was able to produce results now.
No, the fact that I was able to reach beyond the Classics
on my own two feet in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Wasn't all of that
ultimately fueled by 'emotion'?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I began to wonder if perhaps I didn't truly understand the real power of 'emotions'."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...I already knew that internal and external interference
caused by 'emotions' has a significant effect on muscle movement."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, the effect was far greater than expected.
Witnessing such potential got me truly excited!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt this will be the key to future research
in order to reach even greater limits!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I've been doing extensive research
referencing a wide range of literature.
With those words, Agnes Tachyon narrowed her eyes and looked at me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I have a guinea pig who's exceptionally
susceptible to emotional swings, so the timing is ideal."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Over these three years, thanks to your "emotions," a great deal—
She started to say, but quickly closed her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No, that topic is... irrelevant.
I shall refrain from discussing it."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Shut up, don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, in any case, you are my Trainer,
so fulfill your duties as my guinea pig!"
Afterward, I ended up being roped into doing personality quizzes until the sun set.

—Whatever the case, the days walking alongside
Agnes Tachyon had begun once again.
